Most information can be obtained in the methodology part. However, sometimes the authors did not provide the formula for the effect size reporting.

Some studies would extract means of a given variable (arm-based meta-analysis), or effect sizes that were already calculated in primary studies. In the former, there is no formula needed and it is not technically an "effect size" sensu stricto; and in the latter, the effect sizes are already available and the formulas are likely in the original studies (and may vary between studies). I think it is relevant to have an "NA" category here for these cases.
